2. Procedure
2.1.  Procedure
Title: 2 GW HVDC Offshore Platform and Converter System (2 GW HVDC System) for the 
NorthSeaConnector 1 Project (Yard Scope)
Description: The overall scope of supply and services of the project shall be for the turnkey 
delivery of the 2 GW offshore converter system comprises to engineer, procure, construct
/manufacture, transport to offshore, install, commission onshore/offshore and test as an EPCI 
Contractor the offshore converter platform in the area N-11.1 as well as an onshore converter 
at a 50Hertz substation. The scope consists of the respective complete substructure and 
topside of the offshore platform including transport & installation and the civil works of the 
onshore substation including its hvdc systems, both with the corresponding electrical 
equipment, non-electrical equipment as well as other reasonably required scope and services 
for a fully functional 2 GW converter system ready for operation and connection to the German 
HV grid. Note: The scope of this award is limited to the yard scope (offshore converter station, 
including the jacket substructure, topside, auxiliary and ancillary systems, as well as the 
transport and installation) of the offshore platform and jacket substructure. The onshore 
converter station, including all associated civil works and HVDC electrical equipment for the 
onshore station and the offshore platform remains unchanged since the initial award in June 
2024.

6. Results
Value of all contracts awarded in this notice: 1,00 EUR
Direct award
: 
Justification for direct award: The contract can be provided only by a particular economic 
operator because of an absence of competition for technical reasons
Other justification: The underlying offshore grid connection system NorthSeaConnector 1 
Project must be integrated into a Multi-Terminal-Hub and must be interoperable with the 
converters already being implemented by Tennet TSO GmbH (TTG). In order to guarantee the 
connectivity of the HVDC connection via the DC hub Heide, which is bindingly specified in the 
confirmed NEP 2037/2045, and the interoperability of the 50Hertz components in this "closed 
system", a technically compatible converter pair must be procured, as was procured by TTG 
from Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG in April 2023. For market and technical 
reasons, the offshore platform, in which the offshore converter will be installed, is integral part 
of the EPCI contract. The EPCI contract for the yard scope was therefore concluded with 
NSORe NSC 1 GmbH. The HVDC scope remains with Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. 
KG.. Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG and NSORe NSC 1 GmbH form a consortium. 
For reasons of confidentiality of business secrets, the contract value will not be published for 
the moment. A standard market price in the nine-figure range was agreed.
